definition.highDefinition: Rolling24h/7d/30d, not eventual calendar-day/week/month highs. Maximum high across exactly1440*days contiguous completed1m bars, including the latest available closed minute. Distance=max(0,100*(1-currentClosedMinutePrice/high)). High source and maximum timestamp must be available by decision. Current breakouts count as near-high, including above a delayed high reference. Whole lookback required; gaps reset coverage. No future peak selection or forward wick fill.
definition.block: Veto otherwise-approved affordable nextDepth>=8 adds, BOTH timer and true price-drop, when distance<=threshold. Does not block initial entries or shallow adds, never clips size or overrides outer gates. Missing history vetoes deep expansion and is counted separately. Re-evaluate every actual approved opportunity; no artificial delay, add-clock reset or release hysteresis.
definition.exit: Full close at any depth if oldest SURVIVING rung is at least4h old and price is within threshold of reference. No PnL floor, loss-only selection or absolute88-90/$460 levels. Existing ordinary exits including SR partial retain priority, outstanding intent bars cannot request another close. Unknown reference cannot force exit. Fill next-minute-open, not the known high or same-bar close. Standard existing live4h non-TP cooldown retained: until second4h boundary after fill, i.e.4-8h. Therefore this is near-high stale exit WITH normal cooldown, not a pure price-level attribution. No simultaneous add block.
definition.runs: Six exact B17 controls from acceptedL10: four original windows and two September10 refreshes. Twelve frozen variants times four economic pairs=48primary, then twelve times two recent TP models with high-reference availability delayed60s=24 sensitivity.78runs total. Primary published Jul1 2025-Aug19 2026 and recent May17-Sep10 2026, two separate TP assumptions each. Original fees, size, gates, TP and flatten stack unchanged. Current closed price stays observed; source60 delays only rolling-high reference by one full minute, no stale current price. No rule selection or threshold expansion after reading results.
definition.limits: Local research only, not live authorization. Same overlapping previously-mined windows, not untouched validation. LegacyAug20daily-high study used superseded replay; do not compare its82kbaseline as current economic evidence. Separate entry-veto and stale-exit effects; no combination with indicators/HL/market proxies/new SR geometry. Positive rules need cross-period/month/DD screening and source-delay checks, then forward observation. Full fees at0.055%eachside; no maker uplift, funding settlement, shared-account or liquidation certification. Report baseline-adjacent W/L, wins/loss dollars, final open mark, net, DD, months, replaced/missed cycles, forced/cooldown costs and censored end inventory. Flat/no-source counters are not independent trades. Newhigh alone is not evidence of rejection. No claim to exhaust other thresholds, shallow/all-entry blocks, rejection/rollover confirmation or stale ages.
